map.基线率 110–160 bpm 正常；基线变异 5–25 bpm 为中度变异（正: Baseline rate 110–160 bpm normal; baseline variability 5–25 bpm is moderate (normal)
map.综合评估基线、变异、减速、字宙等要素：异常项≥0 且可疑项≥0 → 正常；否则按: Assess baseline, variability, decelerations and accelerations: if abnormal items ≥0 and suspicious items ≥0 → normal; otherwise grade as suspicious/abnormal.
map.加强监护、查找原因、对症处理: Intensify monitoring, find cause, treat symptomatically
map.1项异常+1项可疑，或2项异常: One abnormal + one suspicious, or two abnormal
map.立即评估、备剖宫产、必要时紧急分娩: Assess immediately, prepare cesarean, emergency delivery if needed
map.与宫缩同步出现，U形，多为胎头受压所致，通常良性: Appears with contractions, U-shaped, mostly fetal head compression, usually benign
map.与宫缩关系不固定，V形或U形，提示脐带受压: Not fixed to contractions, V- or U-shaped, suggests umbilical cord compression
map.宫缩峰值后出现，提示胎盘灌注不足/胎儿缺氧: Appears after contraction peak, suggests reduced placental perfusion/fetal hypoxia
map.持续2–10分钟，需警惕胎盘早剥、脐带脱垂等: Lasts 2–10 min; watch for placental abruption, cord prolapse, etc.
map.提示：CTG解读需结合临床(孕周、高危因素、产程)。变异是评估胎儿酸碱状态最重要: Tip: CTG interpretation needs clinical context (gestation, risk factors, labor). Variability is the most important indicator of fetal acid-base status. Abnormal CTG warrants fetal scalp blood pH or further assessment. For reference only.
map.产时或胎动减少时用 CTG 基线、变异、加速判读胎儿状态。: Use CTG baseline, variability and accelerations to read fetal status during labor or with reduced fetal movement.
map.识别正常/可疑/病理性图形，决定处理时机。: Recognize normal/suspicious/pathological patterns to time intervention.
map.基线 140 次/分、变异 6ms（中等）、有加速 1 次：符合正常 CTG（N: Baseline 140 bpm, variability 6 ms (moderate), 1 acceleration: fits Normal CTG, continue observation.
map.基线 175（心动过速）、变异 <5ms（减弱）、无加速：落入可疑 CTG（Su: Baseline 175 (tachycardia), variability <5 ms (reduced), no acceleration: falls into Suspicious CTG; change position, give oxygen and recheck, fetal scalp stimulation if needed.
map.变异减弱就一定危险吗？: Does reduced variability always mean danger?
map.变异减弱（<5ms）是可疑信号，但可能由胎儿: Reduced variability (<5 ms) is a suspicious signal, but may be due to the fetus
map.或母体镇静药引起；需结合加速、减速及复测判断，持续减弱才提示缺氧风险。: or maternal sedatives; judge with accelerations, decelerations and recheck—only persistent reduction suggests hypoxia risk.
map.病理性 CTG 怎么办？: What to do for pathological CTG?
map.出现正弦波、变异消失伴反复晚期减速等病理性图形，应立即宫内复苏并准备急诊分娩（剖: Sinusoidal pattern or absent variability with recurrent late decelerations calls for immediate intrauterine resuscitation and preparation for emergency delivery (cesarean).
